title: Missing timeout argument for method '…' can cause your program to hang indefinitely.
summary: Used when a method needs a 'timeout' parameter in order to avoid waiting for a long time. If no timeout is specified explicitly the default value is used. For example for 'requests' the program will never time out (i.e. hang indefinitely). pylint calls it missing-timeout.
message_templates: Missing timeout argument for method '{}' can cause your program to hang indefinitely

title: Do not use nested call of '…'; it's possible to do '…' instead.
summary: Nested calls min(1, min(2, 3)) can be rewritten as min(1, 2, 3). pylint calls it nested-min-max.
message_templates: Do not use nested call of '{}'; it's possible to do '{}' instead

title: Suspicious …-part chained comparison using semantically incompatible operators (…).
summary: Used when there is a chained comparison where one expression is part of two comparisons that belong to different semantic groups ("<" does not mean the same thing as "is", chaining them in "0 < x is None" is probably a mistake). pylint calls it bad-chained-comparison.
message_templates: Suspicious {}-part chained comparison using semantically incompatible operators ({})

title: Checks for files with multiple trailing blank lines.
summary: Trailing blank lines in a file are superfluous. Ruff takes this rule from pycodestyle. It is in preview.
message_templates: Too many newlines at end of {}
